input.purpose: Checking on you at the Velantora Helsinki pickup for the BMW M4, where the car could not be released.
questions: Are you still at the site, or where are you now?
Has the desk told you anything new about the car since 10:57?
If the car is confirmed later today, could you come back for it, and until what time?
Do you need travel or anything else from us for your way back?

steps.summary: Simulated call Yara Sivellin. I'm still at Velantora Helsinki, waiting in the reception area. No, the desk has nothing new since 10:57; they still can't find the BMW M4 in the handover list and haven't said when they'll know more. Yes, I could come back for it if it's confirmed by around 1

input.text: Driver is still in reception at Velantora Helsinki at 12:00 Helsinki time; the desk still can't find the BMW M4 in the handover list and has no time for an answer.

The site has not identified which car this is. It sees a similar stock reference but won't release without confirmation. The customer says not to substitute a car and was calling their stock team at 10:39 Helsinki time. They have not replied since.
Driver can come back for the car if it is confirmed by about 15:00 Helsinki time today. They asked for a train ticket home and confirmation of how their waiting time is paid. Nothing is booked.
Delivery promise is 26 Oct 12:00–17:00 Helsinki time, so the late pickup does not yet threaten it. The booked pickup slot (09:00–11:00 Helsinki) has passed.

input.title: Release the driver now: pay waiting time and a train ticket home, and keep a return option until 15:00 Helsinki time
input.rationale: The driver has waited about 3 hours, and the 30 minutes they offered ran out at about 11:27 Helsinki time. Neither the site nor the customer has confirmed where the car is. The delivery promise of 26 Oct leaves room to collect on another day, so keeping the driver at the site only adds cost.
